tool.help:
What it does ------------
``ErrorCount.sh`` estimates how many genotypes in a dDocent VCF are likely to be wrong because they rest on very few reads. For genotypes supported by one, two, three, four or five reads it counts the heterozygous and homozygous calls and reports the range of possible errors, assuming a 50% (low estimate) and a 25% (high estimate) chance of seeing the second allele of a heterozygote in a single read.
The report ends with the total number of genotypes, the overall error rate range and the "scorched earth" rate, i.e. the error rate that would result if every low-depth homozygous call were wrong.
Output ------
A plain text report. Use it to decide whether the depth filters of the dDocent Filters tool tool are strict enough: an error rate above a few percent calls for more stringent depth cutoffs or for removing the individuals with the lowest coverage.
